news.title: Virtual Vaults verlengt op Brainpark I Rotterdam

summary: Virtual Vaults. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Rotterdam-based data room platform for mid-market dealmaking, a recognised visa sponsor that shows pay on its posting.

culture.text: Provides virtual data rooms that help advisors and deal teams run due diligence and close deals faster.
Has a customer success team that stays involved through every stage of a deal.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Virtual Vaults Nederland B.V.
Its one current opening, a senior software engineering role in Rotterdam, does not ask for Dutch and shows the salary.

growth.text: Describes itself as the leading data room provider in the Benelux and says it is expanding rapidly across Europe.
Extended its office lease at Brainpark I in Rotterdam.
